consistency.title: This panel disagrees with itself
consistency.lede: The figures below were published by the company. We do not correct them — we show that two of them cannot both hold.
consistency.energy: It states {stated} kcal per portion. The fat, carbohydrate and protein on the same panel come to {implied} kcal, which is {percent}% away.
consistency.saturates: It states {saturates} of saturated fat against {fat} of fat in total. Saturates are part of the fat, so there cannot be more of them.
consistency.sugars: It states {sugars} of sugars against {carbohydrate} of carbohydrate in total. Sugars are part of the carbohydrate, so there cannot be more of them.
consistency.weDoNotCorrect: Which figure is the wrong one we do not know and will not guess. We transcribe what the company published, with the date we read it.
